prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a parking lot collision in Baytown, Texas, and has neck strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1475; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thanks for taking the time to speak with me today. This call is being recorded for claim processing purposes. Can you confirm you're comfortable continuing?

A: Yes, that's fine.

Q: Great. Can you walk me through what happened in the parking lot?

A: I was pulling out of a space near the store entrance. It was busy, and I was backing slowly. I felt a bump on the rear passenger side and stopped right away.

Q: Did you see the other vehicle before the contact?

A: No, not until after. I think it was coming down the aisle behind me, and I didn't check my mirror well enough.

Q: How fast were you going when you made contact?

A: Very slow, maybe walking speed. It wasn't a hard impact, but I felt it in my neck.

Q: Did you go to a doctor or urgent care afterward?

A: Yes, I went to urgent care the same afternoon. They diagnosed a neck strain and gave me a muscle relaxer and told me to rest and use ice.

Q: Are you currently experiencing any symptoms?

A: Yes. I have stiffness in the neck, and it hurts when I turn my head to the left. Sitting at a desk for long periods makes it worse.

Q: Have you had any prior neck or back problems?

A: Nothing serious. I had some stiffness a couple of years ago after sleeping wrong, but it went away on its own.

Q: Has anyone else been in the vehicle with you?

A: No, I was alone.

Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add to your statement?

A: Just that I'm trying to keep up with my physical therapy appointments, and I'd like to know what the next steps are for my vehicle repair.

Q: Thank you. We'll follow up with you shortly on both items.

A: Thanks.
